stepExplanation: The Cape Floristic Region is dominated by fynbos ('fine bush' in Afrikaans), a unique shrubland vegetation type. Fynbos is characterized by proteas, ericas (heathers), and restios (reed-like plants). It contains over 9,000 plant species, 70% of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
stepBody: What is the name of the unique vegetation type that dominates the Cape Floristic Region?
